# IP-04 Independent Plan Review — CR-012 / FEAT34

**Verdict: PASS**

Fix cycle 2 in `docs/implementation-plan.md` v0.2.0b resolves all three IP-05 Major findings
without changing the accepted IP-01/IP-02/IP-03 boundary or regressing the six IP-04 fixes.
This PASS approves the plan as a conditional planning artifact only; it does not approve
implementation, deployment, runtime admission, delivery, MSP promotion, or release.

## Audit history

| Review | Verdict | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Initial review | NEEDS REVISION | Six findings: all-gates opening condition, absent H8 topology, displayed double allocation, missing default-off table, missing preflight release DoD/link, and missing team-sizing formula. |
| Fix cycle 1 re-review | PASS | All six findings are resolved. Scope, package/risk arithmetic, canary order, blocker truth, and conditional-state boundaries remain unchanged. |
| IP-05 final audit | NEEDS REVISION | Three Major findings: absent H3 configuration topology, unresolved AO/VO-FE authority conflict, and incomplete bidirectional traceability/dependency inventory. |
| Fix cycle 2 re-review | PASS | All three IP-05 Major findings are resolved; all prior IP-04 gates remain passing. |

## Initial review findings — resolved in fix cycle 1

1. **[P0] Replace the impossible all-gates opening condition with slice-applicable gates.**
   Plan `:15–21` says no code, schema, generated artifact, runtime admission, delivery, or
   release is ready until **H0..H12** is accepted. This contradicts the plan's own H6 code stop
   and H12 definition: H12 requires tests, migration evidence, smoke, and rollback rehearsal
   that implementation must produce. Rewrite it so code/schema/generated work requires the
   applicable H0–H6 gates; functional binding requires H8; runtime/delivery/agent actions
   require their applicable H9–H11 gates; and the configuration/runtime release boundaries
   require the respective H12 approval. Preserve the preflight warning and no-implementation
   claim while removing the circular prohibition.

2. **[P1] Make H8 explicit in the DAG and configuration critical path.**
   In plan `:176–199`, `BE-02` and `BE-03` flow directly to FE-02 and BE-02 flows directly to
   AO-02; no H8 node receives BE-02, BE-03, and executed VER-01 evidence. This contradicts
   plan `:259`, `:313`, and accepted IP-03's structural order. Add an H8 acceptance node with
   dependencies from BE-02, BE-03, and VER-01 evidence; make H8 the predecessor of FE-02 and
   functional AO-02 binding (with H2 still required for `/office`). Add H8 to the written
   configuration critical path and retain AO-01 as a non-blocking static shell.

3. **[P1] Remove displayed double allocation in the later-phase roadmap.**
   Plan `:298–304` allocates REL-01 in the 45-point S7–S9 row and again as 10 points in S9;
   it also allocates REL-02 in the 109-point S10–S14 row and again as 21 points in S14. The
   displayed rows therefore total 291 even though the summary arithmetic says 260. Keep each
   package allocated once. If the S9/S14 rows are scheduling detail, label their points as
   already included (or give them no allocation) and make that unambiguous.

4. **[P1] Add the required default-off feature/server-gate table.**
   Plan §§3, 6, and 9 state the invariant in prose but do not provide the required explicit
   mapping. Add a compact table that identifies, at minimum: disabled group capabilities and
   `runtimeAdmission: not_requested` (server admission/H9); activation requests as preflight
   only (H8/H9); report configuration versus send/enqueue (H9/H10); Agent Office presence versus
   Talk/Assign (H2/H8/H11); and release/canary (H12). For every row, name the default-off UI
   state, server-side enforcement/evidence, gate owner, and fail-closed result. A UI state or
   saved configuration must never be the gate evidence.

5. **[P1] Make preflight criticality a release-DoD condition and link the source.**
   Change plan `:18` to an actual relative Markdown link to
   [`docs/.preflight-report.json`](../../.preflight-report.json) (from the plan's own
   `docs/` location this should render as `[preflight report](.preflight-report.json)`). Add to
   both REL-01 and REL-02 DoD rows at `:412–416`: CRIT-001..003 must be remediated with governed
   evidence, or a specific current finding must have a dated, owner-named, independent accepted
   exception. Current smoke alone is not a substitute for this closure/exception record.

6. **[P2] State an explicit team-sizing formula.**
   Plan `:267–278` gives capacity arithmetic and role names, but lacks the formula required to
   derive the staffed minimum. State the calculation and outcome, for example: one lane lead per
   B/F/V lane because `ceil(max lane commitment / 15) = 1`; plus one delivery owner and one
   independent reviewer; specialists are consulted and add no capacity. Tie the formula to the
   45-point/sprint cap and the non-self-acceptance rule.

## Fix-cycle 1 verification and regression audit

- **Slice-applicable gates:** Plan `:15–21` now limits code/schema/generated work to the
  applicable H0–H6 gates, functional binding to H8, runtime/delivery/agent actions to H9–H11,
  and releases to H12. This removes the H12-before-code circularity.
- **H8 topology:** Plan §5.1 explicitly converges BE-02, BE-03, and executed VER-01 evidence
  at H8 before FE-02 and AO-02; AO-02 also retains the H2 permission dependency. §5.2 includes
  H8 in the configuration critical path and keeps AO-01 non-blocking.
- **Allocation arithmetic:** Plan §7.3 marks S9 REL-01 and S14 REL-02 as included scheduling
  details. The only allocations are `95 + 11 + 45 + 109 = 260` across the accepted 19 packages.
- **Default-off enforcement:** Plan §6.2 covers group capabilities/admission, preflight,
  report delivery, Agent Office presence, Talk/Assign, and release/canary. Each is explicit
  about UI state, authoritative server evidence, owner/gate, and fail-closed outcome.
- **Preflight release evidence:** Plan opening links `[preflight report](.preflight-report.json)`;
  §12 requires remediation or the specific independently accepted exception record at both
  release boundaries.
- **Staffing:** Plan §7.1 derives one B, one F, and one V lead from the 15-point lane cap,
  then adds one delivery owner and one independent reviewer; consultants add no capacity.

The accepted 19-package/260-point scope and exact discrete complexity rubric remain intact.
All ten mandatory risks retain their accepted P/I values and score classes. The production
sequence remains non-circular: non-production evidence and independent review precede H12,
H12 authorizes REL-02's controlled canary, then canary telemetry precedes a separate human
promotion, controlled-expansion, or rollback decision. The plan still distinguishes the indexed
base ADR-068 from the pending Visual Office amendment/module, complements rather than supersedes
the frontend plan, keeps configuration separate from runtime/delivery, carries metadata and
version history, and claims no implemented, deployed, or live capability.

## Fix-cycle 2 verification

- **Major 1 — H3 topology:** Plan §§5.1–5.2 makes H3 a predecessor of BE-02/03 and their
  convergence with executed VER-01 at H8. The H8 ledger row, S5/S6 entries, and M2 repeat the
  canonical-binding ownership/revocation requirement while AO-01 remains independently buildable.
- **Major 2 — frontend authority:** Plan §5.4 supplies the FE/AO/VER/REL to VO-FE-01..08
  crosswalk and adopts the existing frontend plan's combined VO-FE-05 topology. AO-02 completes
  VO-FE-05 and is a predecessor of VO-FE-06/REL-01; the plan expressly requires a separately
  approved frontend-plan amendment for any static-shell-only release.
- **Major 3 — traceability and dependencies:** Plan §§2.2, 3.2, and 11 map the exact eight
  sources, all 19 IP-REQs, all eight NFR-VO IDs, 13 stable evidence IDs, all 19 packages, and
  consuming gates/windows in forward and reverse directions. §§2.6 and 6.2 add the dependency/
  infrastructure inventory and identify actual or unresolved server-gate/flag/kill-switch
  mechanisms without inventing implementation names.

Deterministic recount: 19 package rows, 260 total points, zero factor mismatches; ten mandatory
risks, zero P×I mismatches; 19 reverse-package rows, 19 unique IP-REQ rows, eight NFR definitions
and mappings, 13 stable evidence rows, and H0–H12 ledger coverage. Preflight CRIT-001..003,
the base-ADR-versus-pending-amendment distinction, configuration/runtime separation, and the
non-production evidence → H12 → REL-02 canary → human disposition order remain intact.
